title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E03 — Death Sentence
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey investigate the site of Louisiana's first double execution; as they dive into the murky waters of the old Beauregard Parish jail's murderous past, the resident spirits begin to tell an unexpected tale.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E01 — Roff Family Rituals
When the spirit of a possessed girl starts calling, Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey pick up the line; while communicating with the ghostly caller in Watseka, Ill., they find there's more to her death than anyone suspected.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E02 — Dead and Forgotten
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into a Michigan asylum to determine what truly haunts its abandoned grounds; as the guys sift through the facility's sordid past, they encounter restless souls who refuse to be forgotten in death.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E04 — Cross My Heart
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey do time in the most haunted penitentiary in the Wild West; they delve into ghost stories and uncover gruesome truths to confront paranormal presences lurking inside the Yuma Territorial Prison.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E05 — Ghost Town Throwdown
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey venture to Vulture Mine to dig into the haunting at the Old West's most notorious gold mine; the unexplained activity turns violent, injuring the crew and making the guys the target of a dangerous presence.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E06 — Go to the Light
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey dive into the Gulf Coast's Pensacola Lighthouse to shine a light on a horrific haunting; as the guys illuminate the site's past, they find the lighthouse itself may play an unexpected role.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E07 — Hotel Hell
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey check into Wisconsin's Karsten Hotel to uncover which spirits reside in the once luxurious lodgings; they discover that the terrifying ghostly whispers may reveal unexpected secrets about the hotel's past.

title: Ghost Brothers: Lights Out
description:
S01 E08 — Flight or Fright
Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey climb aboard the USS Lexington to confront a dark paranormal presence; as they dive into the World War II aircraft carrier's history, they reveal there is more to the haunting than anyone expected.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S20 E07 — Binion's Hotel and Casino
Zak and the crew investigate two historic hotels inside an infamous Las Vegas casino with a dark and violent history; the long-abandoned hotels, sealed off and left frozen in time, have created a paranormal pressure cooker just waiting to explode.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S20 E08 — The Woodbury: Home of American Horror Story
Zak and the crew investigate the aggressive spirits who roam a 130-year-old estate in Altadena, Calif., that's been used as a location for various films and TV shows.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E04 — Panic in Amarillo
Zak and the crew rush to a private home in Amarillo, Texas, where a family is reaching its breaking point with an aggressive entity; it's the guys' most complex and challenging investigation yet as they search for the truth.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E01 — Crescent Hotel
Zak and the crew investigate a historic hotel plagued by restless spirits in Eureka Springs, Ark.; they capture a curtain moving on its own and make contact with Michael, the hotel's most active and notorious ghost.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E03 — Mount Wilson Ranch
In eastern Nevada, Zak and the crew investigate a mysterious ranch known for its concentration of supernatural energy and countless reports of extraterrestrial activity.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E07 — A Haunting in Scottsdale
Zak and the crew investigate an Arizona home sitting on land once occupied by a Native American tribe; the owner claims he's been affected by a dark, aggressive energy and believes an ancient entity is haunting his property.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E05 — Union Hotel
Zak and the crew travel to the Bay Area to investigate aggressive paranormal activity at a historic hotel that has endured the brutal California Gold Rush, a smallpox epidemic and a period as a seedy flophouse.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E02 — St. Ignatius Hospital
Zak and the crew stick together as they investigate a 127-year-old hospital in Colfax, Wash.; visitors to the abandoned building report hearing strange growls and being attacked by unseen hands.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S21 E06 — Idaho State Tuberculosis Hospital
In Gooding, Idaho, Zak and the crew investigate an inn that used to be a tuberculosis hospital; the owners and their staff have been terrorized by whispering voices, ghostly children and the spirit of an angry old man.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S22 E02 — Albion Castle
Zak and the crew are in San Francisco to investigate a mysterious castle built on top of sacred caverns said to be haunted by a female apparition; the current owners claim to be plagued by paranormal activity in almost every corner of the property.
